description: This file defines the SupportedReleaseValidator class, which validates that updated Drupal projects are secure and supported by checking their versions against a list of installable releases. It implements event subscription to trigger validation during project updates.

classes.name: SupportedReleaseValidator
classes.description: A class that validates whether updated Drupal projects are secure and supported by checking their versions against known installable releases. It subscribes to pre-application update events to perform validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for inspecting Composer packages and locating project paths.

methods.name: isSupportedRelease
methods.description: Checks if a given project version (semantic or legacy) is in the list of supported installable releases.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates staged package updates to ensure they are supported and have project info, adding errors to the event if not.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to, specifically the PreApplyEvent for validation.
